about.title: About Kimeru Auto
about.subtitle: The story behind the platform, why it is open source, and who built it.

backStory.title: The story
backStory.p1: Kimeru Auto was born from a passion many of us share: the love for cars. But it also came from a real frustration, the genuine difficulty of figuring out which car fits your lifestyle and, above all, your budget.
backStory.p2: In Brazil, the used-car market has become a minefield. In recent years we have seen prices of pre-owned vehicles skyrocket, often exceeding the fair value of the car. At the same time, scams and fraud in used-car sales have become increasingly common: rolled-back odometers, fake documentation, financing with predatory rates, and tricks hidden in the fine print of contracts.
backStory.p3: Between high prices, market traps, and the struggle of comparing dozens of spec sheets, buying a car has become too stressful. The idea here is simple: give you the right data, at the right time, so the decision is yours, not a salesperson's.

openSource.title: Why open source?
openSource.p1: Kimeru Auto is an open-source project, built with full transparency. All the code is public: anyone can contribute, audit, or suggest improvements. We believe a tool that helps people make important financial decisions must be open and trustworthy.
openSource.p2: Our goal is to help car lovers, from Brazil and around the world, buy more consciously: comparing specs objectively and simulating financing to understand exactly what you will pay, avoiding abusive interest rates and unpleasant surprises.

creator.title: About the creator
creator.name: João Pedro Sconetto
creator.bio: Brazilian software engineer passionate about technology, open source, and good stories. When not coding, he is photographing the city, watching F1 and endurance racing, or enjoying a specialty coffee. He believes good software solves real problems for real people, and that sharing knowledge is the best way to grow.

support.title: Support the project
support.text: Kimeru Auto is free and will stay that way. If the platform helped you make a better decision, consider supporting the project with a virtual coffee on Ko-fi. Any contribution helps keep the service running and evolving.

name.title: Where does the name come from?
name.p1: “Kimeru” (決める) is a Japanese word meaning “to decide”. It is the heart of the project: our mission is to give you the right data to decide, with clarity and confidence, which car is ideal for your life.
name.p2: “Auto”, in turn, comes from the German “das Auto” — the word for car. It is a nod to German engineering and the automotive passion that inspires the project.
name.p3: Together, Kimeru Auto is an invitation: decide better, drive better.
